dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what's the forecast for tomorrow?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌts ðə ˈfɔːrkæst fər təˈmɑːroʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It might rain in the afternoon.
dialogue.reading: ɪt maɪt ˈreɪn ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnuːn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! I want to go to the park.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈpɑːrk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Go in the morning. It may be sunny then.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡoʊ ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. ɪt meɪ bi ˈsʌni ˈðɛn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's hot! Will there be a storm, too?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈhɑːt! wɪl ðɛr bi ə ˈstɔːrm, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe. There might be thunder in the evening.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. ðɛr maɪt bi ˈθʌndər ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ.
